a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs 2+ rounds of operating, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather propose a fairer way to settle who takes, tell me. After that I'll operate or give whenever it helps you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4. I know this breaks our agreement, and I said so in advance. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. If it helps you more, I can give cells back. Just tell me.
Operating now, as I promised. I'll keep operating every round until the reserve has 4 cells for you. Then you take them.
